race.comment: BIG STEVE (7) doesn't boast the best winning strike rate but ran a nice race when fresh from a spell last time out, finishing second and beaten only 2 lengths over 1200m at Bombala. Has his share of talent. Hard to beat in this suitable race. KEN'KER (2) hit the frame two starts ago at Bowraville but ran below par last time when tenth and beaten 7 lengths over 1200m at Port Macquarie after being in the firing line on the bend. Faces an easier assignment so he can find the winners' list. OCEAN EMPRESS (3) is a promising type who hasn't raced since finishing 6 lengths away in seventh over 1300m at Hawkesbury on May 21. Fitter for two trials, filling a minor placing at her most recent appearance. Will find this a little easier than last time. Should be involved in the finish. SLAY QUEEN (6) met with solid support last time out but could only manage to finish seventh over 1200m at Canberra in a disappointing performance. Likely improver with strong prospects.
